simple.meaning: מַעֲרָךְ (maʻărâk) is a Hebrew word meaning “an arrangement , i.e. (figuratively) mental disposition.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

definitions.full: H4633. maarak [ מַעֲרָךְ ] noun [masculine] arrangement ; — plural construct מַעַרְכֵיסּלֵב Prov 16:1 to man belong arrangements (plans) of the mind (compare לֵב 3 ).
